component.name: Nuvio Linux
component.summary: Linux native media player for browsing, downloading and streaming content

description.p: Nuvio Linux is a desktop media client for browsing metadata, managing collections and watch progress, downloading media, and playing streams from user-installed extensions or user-provided sources.
This is a hard fork of Nuvio Desktop with a native Linux playback stack powered by mpv (hardware-accelerated decoding via VAAPI/NVDEC).
